verdict.rationale: Expensify's 'Ask Expensify AI anything' feature is documented as letting users create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses in plain language with no clicking, configure workspaces and rules by asking, and get answers and charts about account data. This covers natural-language operation of the core product. The one community remark that Concierge support replies are human-written is an old comment about support response times and does not concretely contradict this command feature. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation (beyond a marketing blog post) of supported commands and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.
